…ending withheld.

The path narrowed where the hedges had grown untended, and the walking slowed to accommodate it. There was a gate at the end, and beyond the gate a field, and beyond the field the low grey shoulder of the hills. None of it had changed. That was the strange part — that so much could happen and the land would simply go on holding its shape.
